valuation.note: BIR zonal values are per square metre of LAND. Lot area is inferred from the footprint (footprint / coverage); the structure is replacement cost = footprint x floors x cost per m2. Coverage ratios and non-residential costs are assumptions, not surveyed.
valuation.costSource: Residential: PSA approved-building-permit average, about PHP 10.7k/m2 (2024; declared permit costs, typically below real cost). Commercial 1.4x and industrial 0.8x residential: assumed.

note: Estimate: building inherits its nearest matching street's BIR tax floor; not a parcel value or market price.
